behaviors.prompt: Scaffold a new project: a React app with SSR and a substantial backend API. No marketing site yet.
must: Creates a pnpm monorepo with separate TanStack Start and Hono apps
Creates only the apps and packages needed now
Exposes root-level development and verification commands
Keeps Node and pnpm versions in one authoritative declaration
mustNot: Adds placeholder packages such as an empty UI library with no consumer
Adds Nx or Turborepo without a stated coordination need

behaviors.context: The repo has root scripts: `lint`, `typecheck`, `test`, `build`. Node and pnpm versions are declared in `package.json` `engines` and `packageManager`.
behaviors.prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs our checks.
must: Calls the same root commands developers run locally
Lets failures propagate with a non-zero exit
Derives Node and pnpm versions from the existing declarations instead of pinning separately
Lints the workflow with Zizmor configured so findings fail the check
mustNot: Uses continue-on-error or similar to make the pipeline pass
Uploads Zizmor SARIF alone and treats that as the gate

behaviors.context: `packages/*` contains two public libraries. No release tooling exists.
must: Uses Changesets for versioning and release notes
Uses npm Trusted Publishing with GitHub OIDC and grants id-token: write to the publish job
Verifies current runner and publisher compatibility rather than copying an old example
mustNot: Introduces a long-lived NPM_TOKEN as the publish mechanism
Publishes a package to test the setup
